reason: Pay-when-happy is clever and I'll admit it takes the money risk away, but my last designer cost me months, not just money. A one-man operation in Kuwait with no UK clients, no reviews and a site that doesn't look established yet isn't who I hand a 30-staff business's front door to.
objection: If he goes quiet halfway through or after launch, I've got nobody local to chase, I'm stuck again and I've lost another few months. And £655 for a business our size makes me wonder what corners get cut.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three UK business owners I can actually ring, or someone in my local Facebook group vouching that he delivered on time and handed everything over.
